newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent marked higher as NYMEX up on gasoline.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent marked higher as NYMEX up on gasoline.

text.p: August Brent futures were untraded at midday on SIMEX Wednesday but they were marked higher off the back of a gasoline rally in the U.S..
August Brent, which expires later on Wednesday, was quoted at $18.40/$18.55 per barrel, up from London's settlement of $18.39 after a gain on the day of 57 cents.
NYMEX August crude, trading on ACCESS, was last traded at $19.76 per barrel, up nine cents from New York, which rose 68 to $19.67.
A rally in the NYMEX gasoline market on Tuesday pushed crude values higher because of expectations of a strong draw in API data.
The data, released after the close of business on NYMEX in the U.S., showed a greater gasoline draw than had been expected and sparked a rally on ACCESS.
August gasoline rose 1.59 cent per gallon to 59.94 cents in New York and added a further 0.61 on ACCESS to last trade at 60.55.
